DASHBOARD_TOKEN.description: Token login: generate at least 32 random characters. [Authentication](https://github.com/ImLukeF/ai-spend-dashboard/blob/main/docs/auth.md). Enter `-` if using Access.

ANTHROPIC_ADMIN_KEY.description: [Create an Anthropic admin key](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/manage-claude/admin-api). Enter `-` if unused.

OPENAI_ADMIN_KEY.description: [Create an OpenAI admin key](https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/admin-apis). Enter `-` if unused.

OPENROUTER_MANAGEMENT_KEY.description: [Create an OpenRouter management key](https://openrouter.ai/docs/guides/overview/auth/management-api-keys). Enter `-` if unused.

ENFORCEMENT_MODE.description: Use dry_run initially. off disables actions; live requires explicit config targets. Enter `-` for dry_run.
